record_audits.conflict_context: Database-only APD6 annotations beyond Table 2/Supplementary Table 1 are preserved as source_conflict with primary-source values retained in final activity rows.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP row 176667 reports peptide 4 E. coli MIC as 3.1 µM, while primary Table 2 and APD6 AP04682 support 1.3 µM; final activity uses 1.3 µM and preserves the DBAASP rows as source_conflict.
APD6 free-text similarity/HC50-style annotations are not fully present in the opened local primary material; core sequence and Table 2 activity values are source supported.
